composition_question: IS THIS COMMITTED RELEASE SUFFICIENT TO EXECUTE EXACTLY ONE RETAINED-ONLY REPRESENTATIVE EXPERT RECOVERY WITHOUT CHECKPOINT ACCESS, WITHOUT LEDGER MOVEMENT, AND WITHOUT AUTHORIZING ANY DOWNSTREAM AGGREGATION?
composition_answer: YES. Both cycle-1 required repairs are verified fixed in hash-rebound committed bytes at 127ed2a. (R1-NBR-1) The bound release wrapper (sha 9242bbf2..., rebound in the release) now contains require_environment() called from preflight() on both --preflight-only and --execute paths, before the validator subprocess, before the executor preflight, before any retained-payload open, and before any durable attempt-start or expert computation: it fail-closes with distinct RuntimeErrors unless sys.version_info[:3]==(3,14,6), numpy.__version__=='2.4.5', sys.byteorder=='little', and all five thread variables (OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, OMP_NUM_THREADS, VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS) equal exactly '1' (unset fails), exactly matching the release's pinned_environment declaration (cpython 3.14.6, numpy 2.4.5, little, thread_variables_equal_one:5); the executor subprocess and its two fresh-process reproductions run the same sys.executable with the verified inherited environment, so all_locally_checkable_before_expert_computation is now true in enforcement, not just declaration, restoring and tightening the m1f0 v3 ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH standard (micro-pinned 3.14.6 vs the old (3,14)). (R1-NBR-2) The bound terminalizer (sha 7a3da0b6..., rebound) now enumerates interrupted-attempt outputs with glob '??-expert-*-down.f32le', which fnmatch-verifies against all eight of the executor's actual output names ('00-expert-250-down.f32le' ... '07-expert-28-down.f32le'), and a committed unit test exercises reconcile() against an executor-named artifact and asserts it appears in partial_outputs; a post-computation crash can no longer be durably misrecorded as partial_outputs=[]. The remainder of the composition re-verifies independently at head: all seven binding hashes recompute exactly; the executor (7831568f...), authorization (abbf12bc...), rehearsal (8d156da2..., 20/20 failure paths, 0 real expert executions), ledger adapter (3655b90c...), and cycle-02 ACCEPT authorization review (df9b5192...) are byte-identical to the artifacts verified in cycle 1; the 24-payload/90,439,680-byte retained inventory with 62-before-73 ordering is pairwise identical across release, recovery authorization, and packed-weight-reuse authorization sourced from F017-CANONICAL-EXPERT-OUTPUT-RECOVERY-1, so the path is retained-only with checkpoint_reads=0 and shard_opens=0 and no shard/checkpoint code path exists in the executor; atomic id-weight pairs agree across release, authorization, executor SELECTED_IDS, and validator PAIR_IDS/PAIR_WEIGHTS, and routing weights are never applied numerically, so the stop boundary AFTER_EIGHT_INDIVIDUAL_REPRESENTATIVE_EXPERT_OUTPUTS_BEFORE_WEIGHTED_AGGREGATE is structural and no downstream aggregation is authorized (aggregate_outputs=false, prohibitions routed_aggregate/shared_expert/ffn_completion/s2_construction/direct_dprefix_outputs all true, computation contract aggregate/gpu/blas not permitted); ledger is pinned at 175 before and after with the committed adapter passing; materializer, computation contract, computation source, and all four decoder source bindings recompute exactly; the release itself asserts real_event_authorized=false and approval_asserted=false and grants nothing, with the authoritative single event still gated behind the separate 8-field go-token plus committed ACCEPT approval bound to release_sha256 ccf33fef... (bound by the regenerated preparation evidence) and consumer authority still requiring a COMPLETE terminal. The two unimplemented secondary sub-items of the cycle-1 repairs (environment recording in attempt records; manifest.json in the terminalizer inventory) are adjudicated defense-in-depth, not required, per R2-DID-1 and R2-DID-2. This committed release is sufficient, pending only the separate committed independent approval and go-token it itself requires.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Observed environment is enforced fail-closed but not recorded in attempt-start or terminal records
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: Cycle-1's R1-NBR-1 required repair also asked that the observed environment be recorded in attempt-start and terminal records; the committed fix enforces the pinned environment in the wrapper preflight but the executor (unchanged, byte-identical to the cycle-02-accepted 7831568f...) writes no environment field into attempt-start.json or terminal.json.
defense_in_depth_findings.justification: The substantive risk in R1-NBR-1 was banking canonical authority computed under a drifted environment with all gates green; that is now impossible on the wrapper path because require_environment() fail-closes before the executor is launched, before any retained payload is opened, and before durable attempt-start, and the executor plus both fresh-process reproductions inherit the verified interpreter and environment. Recording is evidentiary only. The residual unrecorded-and-unchecked path is direct executor invocation, which is already the adjudicated carried bypass posture (R2-DID-3): it can mint no committed authority without the approval trail.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Terminalizer inventories the eight f32le outputs but does not record manifest.json presence
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: Cycle-1's R1-NBR-2 required repair also suggested including manifest.json presence in the crash inventory; the committed terminalizer globs only '??-expert-*-down.f32le' and does not report whether manifest.json exists.
defense_in_depth_findings.justification: The defect that made R1-NBR-2 required was a provably empty partial_outputs inventory feeding the pre-attempt-failure adjudication after a post-computation crash; that is fixed and test-pinned. The executor writes manifest.json strictly after all eight atomic output writes, so a manifest cannot exist without f32le outputs that the fixed glob now inventories; manifest presence adds no adjudication signal that the output inventory does not already provide, and output_authority remains NONE_UNLESS_PRIOR_COMPLETE_TERMINAL with resume/retry/second_attempt false regardless.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Carried R1-DID-1: go-token and inner token are synthesizable from committed bytes; one-shot enforcement is path-relative via operator-chosen environment roots; direct executor invocation bypasses the wrapper gates including the new environment gate
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: State/output roots come from PULSARMLX_F017_REP_EXPERT_STATE_ROOT/OUTPUT_ROOT; fresh roots re-enable the wrapper; the executor remains directly invokable with a hand-crafted 4-field inner token, which now also bypasses require_environment() since enforcement lives only in the wrapper process.
defense_in_depth_findings.justification: Adjudicated by design in the accepted authorization cycle-02 review and carried unchanged: no unforgeable secret can live in a git repository, the threat model is honest-operator process discipline, durable attempt-start plus the committed approval trail makes any bypass or re-run evident, and no committed artifact grants consumer authority without a COMPLETE terminal in the reviewed roots.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Carried R1-DID-2: executor transitively imports the module containing the sole checkpoint capability class
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: The executor imports only DecoderPair, PythonIndependentDecoder, RustAcceptedDecoder, canonical_sha256, sha256_path, strict_f32_matvec, strict_f32_silu from f017_canonical_expert_output_production.py, which also defines ProductionShardProvider; the executor contains zero references to it (verified count 0 at head) and all 'shard_open' occurrences are accounting/prohibition strings.
defense_in_depth_findings.justification: The imported module is hash-bound via the computation contract (a48b9353..., recomputed MATCH this review) and verified before compute; the capability is unreachable from any executed path; release prohibitions and access accounting pin shard_opens=0 and checkpoint_reads=0.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Carried R1-DID-3: validator binds wrapper/ledger-adapter/terminalizer only to their self-declared hashes and is itself unpinned; no mutation test covers pinned_environment
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: The validator hardcodes expected hashes for authorization/executor/independent_review/rehearsal but checks only sha(file)==declared-sha for release_wrapper, ledger_adapter, and terminalizer, does not validate the pinned_environment block's values, and no binding pins the validator itself; the 19 mutation rejections include no pinned_environment mutation.
defense_in_depth_findings.justification: The wrapper's environment constants are hardcoded in the wrapper source, not read from the release document, so no document mutation can weaken enforcement; any release-byte mutation changes release_sha256, which the go-token and committed ACCEPT approval pin byte-exactly at execute time; the committed unit tests pin the current repository state; the validator remains one layer of several.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Carried R1-DID-4: internal-reproduce mode permits real expert computation gated only by an environment variable, now also outside the wrapper's environment gate
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: Executor --internal-reproduce requires only PULSARMLX_F017_REPRESENTATIVE_EXPERT_INTERNAL=1 and performs full dual-decode plus expert computation against retained payloads without durable attempt state; invoked directly it does not pass through require_environment(), though when spawned by the authoritative execute path it inherits the wrapper-verified environment.
defense_in_depth_findings.justification: Carried posture from the cycle-02-accepted executor whose hash this release binds: the mode writes nothing durable, emits only per-expert output sha256 values to stdout, cannot create a state root, terminal, or manifest, and can mint no output authority; the authoritative event remains gated by the wrapper chain, and a reproduction under a drifted environment could only cause REPRODUCTION_IDENTITY failure (fail-closed), never wrong banked authority.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Carried R1-DID-5 and R1-DID-6: validator JSON parser accepts duplicate keys the wrapper/executor reject; crash between state-root mkdir and durable attempt-start requires manual adjudication; pinned_environment device CPU_ONLY has no runtime check
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: The validator uses plain json.loads (last-value-wins) while wrapper load() and executor load_json() reject duplicate keys; a crash after state_root.mkdir but before attempt-start.json leaves a state the terminalizer refuses to adjudicate (ACCOUNTING_INTEGRITY_NO_DURABLE_START) and the wrapper permanently blocks (PRIOR_ATTEMPT); the declared device CPU_ONLY is not checked at runtime.
defense_in_depth_findings.justification: Both committed contracts parse clean under duplicate-key rejection (re-verified this review) and the byte-exact release_sha256 pin governs at execute time; the crash window fails closed with no computation and no authority, matching intent; CPU_ONLY is structural: the executor is a pure-numpy CPU path with prohibitions.gpu=true and computation contract gpu_permitted=false and blas_permitted=false.
